Name: Grandpa's Fruit Tree
Author: stardemod
Description: A simple mod that allows you to start your game with a fully grown fruit tree on your farm. The tree spawns near Grandpa's shrine and will provide you with a fruit every day. The type of tree is randomly selected to match the current season, giving you a convenient and early source of fruit right from the beginning of your journey. The fruits produced by the tree make for excellent gifts, and the people of Stardew Valley will be delighted to receive them!
